description: This file defines FastAPI routes and dependencies for authentication, including user registration, login, and JWT token handling. It includes in-memory user storage, request/response models, and security dependencies.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for user registration request containing email and password.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for user login request containing email and password.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for authentication response containing access token, token type, and admin status.

methods.name: get_current_principal
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that validates the Bearer token and returns the JWT payload.

methods.name: require_admin
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that ensures the current principal has admin privileges.

methods.name: register
methods.description: API endpoint to register a new user and return a JWT token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: API endpoint to authenticate a user and return a JWT token.
